claim_text: 1. A method in a computer system for caption synchronization of media programs comprising receiving at least one portion of a media stream and at least one portion of a caption data stream in the computer system, wherein the at least one portion of the media stream and the at least one portion of the caption data stream correspond to an event; and the at least one portion of the media stream comprises timing information and at least one audio component; and utilizing at least one processing unit in the computer system to translate an audio signal into a sequence of word sounds in an audio stream; divide the audio stream into a plurality of overlapping audio stream segments that each correspond to a respective time slice of the audio stream, wherein each audio stream segment overlaps with a temporally adjacent audio stream segment such that temporally adjacent audio stream segments share a portion of the audio stream; translate the audio stream into a string of words using a combination of a base language model and an event specific language model; produce an audio-processed transcript by executing an indexing engine on the string of words, wherein the audio processed transcript includes a text stream of at least a plurality of sequences of words and timing information; align the audio-processed transcript with the at least one portion of the caption data stream; and generate a time synchronized caption data stream by applying the timing information from the audio-processed transcript to the at least one portion of the caption data stream based on the aligning.

2. The method of claim 1 , wherein the at least one portion of the caption data stream includes at least one metadata annotation and the time synchronized caption data stream includes text, and the method comprises searching at least one of text of the time synchronized caption data stream and the at least one metadata annotation.
3. The method of claim 2 , wherein the event specific language model is based on a statistical representation of caption information provided in the at least one portion of the caption data stream.
4. The method of claim 1 , comprising providing at least one search engine with access to the time synchronized caption data stream.

5. A method comprising translating, using an acoustic model engine of a first processing unit, a portion of an audio component of a media stream into at least one sequence of logical word sounds; dividing the at least one sequence of logical word sounds into a plurality of overlapping audio segments, wherein each audio segment overlaps with a temporally adjacent audio segment such that temporally adjacent audio segments share a portion of the sequence of logical word sounds; converting, using a language model engine of a second processing unit, the at least one sequence of logical word sounds into a sequence of textual words; wherein the language model engine is tuned based on a caption stream containing one or more portions of caption information; and producing, using a third processing unit, a time based text by associating the at least one sequence of textual words with a time at which the portion of the audio component arises in the media stream.
6. The method of claim 5 , wherein the caption stream is associated with the media stream.
7. The method of claim 6 comprising providing at least one search engine with access to the time based text.
8. The method of claim 7 , wherein at least two of the first processing unit, the second processing unit, and the third processing unit are executed by a single computing device.
9. The method of claim 5 , wherein the language model engine includes a combination of a base language model and an event specific language model.
10. The method of claim 5 comprising, in the acoustic model engine, recognizing at least one word from acoustic sounds based on an acoustic model based on a sampled recording.
11. The method of claim 10 , wherein the at least one sample recording is based on an event type associated with the media stream.
12. The method of claim 11 , wherein the language model engine includes a combination of a base language and an event specific language model.
13. The method of claim 12 , wherein the event specific language model is selected based on caption information provided in the caption stream.
14. The method of claim 12 , wherein the event specific language model is based on a statistical representation of the caption information provided in the caption stream.

15. The method of claim 5 comprising: aligning the time indexed text with at least one of the one or more portions of caption information; and applying timing information in the time indexed text to at least one of the one or more portions of the caption information aligned to the time indexed text.

16. The method of claim 15 , wherein the aligning of the time indexed text with at least one of the one or more portions of caption information comprises: dividing the one or more portions of caption information into a plurality of discrete caption data segments; comparing at least one of a plurality of text segments based on the plurality of overlapping audio segments to a least one of the plurality of discrete caption data segments; associating the at least one of the plurality of text segments with the at least one of the plurality of discrete caption data segments if the comparison indicates a correlation exists between the at least one of the plurality of text segments and the at least one of the plurality of discrete caption data segments.

17. A method for identifying content related to a media stream based on a search of a database containing time synchronized caption data streams comprising inputting a text based search query into a search engine, wherein the search engine is configured to identify one or more segments of a time synchronized caption data stream responsive to the query, wherein the time synchronized caption data stream is generated pursuant to the methodology of claim 1 ; in response to the identification of the one or more responsive segments of the time synchronized caption data stream, extracting at least one time based location in the media stream which corresponds to the query; providing access to the at least one time based location in the media stream; and upon accessing the at least one time based location in the media stream, presenting the portion of the media stream, at the identified time based location, on a presentation device.

18. The method of claim 1 , wherein the aligning step further comprises: dividing the at least one portion of the caption data stream into a plurality of discrete caption data segments; selecting a first group of two or more audio stream segments; comparing the first group of audio stream segments to a first caption data segment to determine if a correlation exists between the first caption data segment and at least one of the two or more audio stream segments in the first group of two or more audio stream segments; if the correlation does not exist, assessing whether at least one of the two or more audio stream segments in the first group of two or more audio stream segments has an association with a successive caption data segment; and if the association does not exist, repeating the assessing step until an association is found between at least one of the two or more audio stream segments and at least one of the plurality of discrete caption data segments.
